title: Round1 Launches First Simultaneous United States-Japan One Piece Collaboration in 159 Locations
content: Round1 has announced its first-ever simultaneous ONE PIECE collaboration across Japan and the United States, with the limited-time campaign running from July 18 through October 17, 2026 at 159 participating locations, including 100 venues in Japan and 59 in the U.S.
author: Anime Corner

title: Koei Tecmo's Attack on Titan 3 Game Reveals Winter Release in Gameplay Video
content: Koei Tecmo America announced in a new trailer for its Attack on Titan 3 game on Wednesday the game will debut this winter. MAPPA will produce the opening sequence, which the game will add in a later update.
author: ANN

title: The World Is Dancing Anime Gets Special Illustration by Slam Dunk, Vagabond Creator Takehiko Inoue, Reveals Opening Video
content: The World Is Dancing anime is celebrating its debut by releasing the opening video and a special illustration from the acclaimed manga creator Takehiko Inoue. Inoue, best known for Slam Dunk and Vagabond , shared a congratulatory illustration of protagonist Oniyasha with a message celebrating the anime adaptation.
author: Anime Corner

title: Street Fighter 6 Game Introduces 'Yasmine Arrives! Fighting Pass' in Video
content: The official Street Fighter YouTube channel streamed a new video on Wednesday for DLC character Yasmine's "Yasmine Arrives! Fighting Pass" and the other bonuses included in the pass.
author: ANN

title: Patlabor the Case Files Game's 3rd Trailer Highlights 3 Primary Modes
content: Good Smile Company started streaming the third trailer for it and developer Chime Corporation 's Patlabor the Case Files , a new 3D action game based on the Patlabor franchise , on Wednesday. The new video previews the game's three primary modes: Main Mission, Another Side Mission, and Simulator Mode.
author: ANN

title: Persona 4 Revival Game Introduces Characters in New Trailer
content: Atlus revealed a trailer for Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game, on Tuesday introducing the characters. The remake will feature a new English voice cast. The original Persona 4 launched for PlayStation 2 in 2008.
author: ANN

title: 10 Best Anime to Binge on Crunchyroll in July 2026
content: The exciting Summer 2026 anime season is finally here, and Crunchyroll is all set for the debut of some of the most anticipated series of the year. However, while the Summer 2026 lineup already looks amazing, the wait for new episodes each week can be quite daunting.

title: Akiko Okuda's 'Rusuban' Short Manga Inspires Short Anime Film on August 1
content: Kenji Iwaisawa 's ROCK'N ROLL MOUNTAIN ( 100 Meters , ON-GAKU: Our Sound ) animation studio announced on Thursday that it is producing a short anime adaptation of Akiko Okuda 's "Rusuban" (House-Sitting) short manga.
